austin.summary: Austin, you picked last in the snake order and still walked away with two castaways sitting at rank 1 of 21 — Carter and Eric, both grade A. That's 24 counted points, rank 2 (tied) of 5, with the leader at 28 and 48 points still on the table. Ep 3 handed you +8; Ep 4 only +3. Your Draft GPA is 2 and you've watched 2 torches snuffed. Still very much alive.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Carter Krull and Eric Macksoud are both still in the game at 7 pts and rank 1 of 21 — the Sioux Falls livestock farmer and the Windsor Locks counselor are the engine of this roster.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: The top of your draft bit back: Jenna Doore at pick #6 is your reach at rank 17 of 21 with 4 pts and a grade F, and Linnea Capobianco at pick #5 finished with 6 pts and an F.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Eric was your steal at pick #16, and with Carter over on Toka and Eric on Dina, keep your eyes on whether those two A-grade bonds keep converting week after week.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this entire season — Aaliyah at pick #3, gone Ep 1, and the First Blood badge is yours forever. Add the Torch Collector badge with 2 torches snuffed and a 2.25 draft GPA, and yes, you're rank 5 of 5 with 19 counted points. But hear me now: 48 points are still on the table, the leader has 28, and your two remaining names are both ranked 1 of 21. You are very much still in this.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian and Kilby are tied at the very top with 7 pts apiece, rank 1 of 21, both grade A — and Kilby at pick #18 is the steal of your entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah went home first at 0 pts and rank 21 of 21, a grade F at pick #3, and Alexis followed in Ep 5 with 5 pts and a D.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your two Dina men are both still in the game, so watch whether that Ep 3 high of +6 becomes your new normal as those 48 points get handed out.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick and you built a brain trust — a professor, a prosecutor, a baseball exec, a gate agent, and a resident. You're sitting at rank 2 (tied) of 5 with 24 counted points, raw 26, with Rob dropped under best-4. Three of your five are still out there, the leader has 28, and 67 points are still on the table. Draft GPA 2.4. You're very much in this.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Jelly, Mike, and Sharonda are all sitting at 7 pts and ranked 1 of 21 — that's a three-headed engine, and your leftover, Sharonda at pick #21, is grading out at an A.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 was the reach — 3 pts, rank 18 of 21, an F, and third voted out in Ep 3 — and Rob's quit that same episode left you 2 pts that got dropped anyway.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You dipped from your best week in Ep 3 (+7) to your worst in Ep 4 (+3), so watch whether your Idol Whisperer roster — 2 idols and advantages found — turns that hardware into points.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you picked 2nd and built a team with muscle, mischief, and a microphone. You sit 4th of 5 with 22 counted points, but the leader has 28 and there are 67 points still on the table — that is nothing in Survivor math. Three of your four are still in the game, your best week was Ep 3 at +6, your worst was Ep 2 at +3, and your draft GPA sits at 2.5. You're in contention. Stay loud.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Brady Booker at pick #19 is your steal of the draft — 7 pts and rank 1 of 21, matched stride for stride by Kristin Flickinger and Ori Jean-Charles, also 7 pts and rank 1 of 21.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani was your reach at pick #12 and her torch went out second, Ep 2, leaving you a single point and a rank of 20 of 21.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Kristin and Brady on Toka with Ori on Savu means you've got a foot in two camps — watch whether those grade-A engines keep stacking points while the gap to 28 shrinks.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted 4th and somehow built a wall. Four of 4 still in the game, 28 counted points, rank 1 of 5, and a 3.75 draft GPA to back it up. Seven boots have come and gone and not one of them was yours — Untouchable, Wire-to-Wire, Idol Whisperer, the whole shelf. Ep 1 gave you +4, Ep 3 gave you +8, and 86 points are still on the table. Remarkable.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying it alone — Lewis, Maggie, Devin, and Thien An are all sitting on 7 pts and all four rank 1 of 21, with Thien An the steal of the draft at pick #17.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: If there's a soft spot it's Lewis Kelly, your #4 pick and the only B grade on a roster otherwise stacked with A's.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your roster leads the field with 2 idols and advantages found — watch how Maggie and Thien An navigate sharing a Toka tribe with 86 points still out there.
